title: Four moves when you return to work.
items: Does the cooperative contract scope actually match our need, or should we run our own RFP?
Draft the letter a losing bidder would file before you post the RFP.
Ask for the bad options too.
Ten options to stop losing track of requests, including three we would never consider.
A department director wants a bid waiver. Rehearse that meeting first.
hl: The tool widens what you're willing to consider. The judgment stays yours.
notes: Added summary slide. The four moves are done, so close the loop in one pass: one line per move and one procurement example each. Click once per move. Then say the last line: the tool widens the range, the judgment stays theirs. The four written move slides sit behind this one, hidden, if you want to open one.
